tagline: An Everlong Midnight, tucked into one box.
heroImageAlt: The Midnight Margarita Club box, candle, and glassware
insideParagraph1: Each Everlong Midnight contains handcrafted pieces, botanical elements, ingredients for the evening, and a handful of Club traditions you'll discover as the night unfolds.
insideParagraph2: Created, gathered, and chosen to carry you through the night – from the first spark to last call.
insideParagraph3: Some things were made by hand. Some were gathered from the garden and woods. Some will be gone by morning. Others were made to stay with you.
insideClosingLine: We won't tell you everything that's inside – that's part of your discovery.

items.title: THE FIRST SPARK
items.description: Hand-poured beeswax candle + the beginning of the evening.

items.alt: Ribbed glass tumbler for the Midnight Margarita
items.title: THE MIDNIGHT MARGARITA
items.description: A cocktail ritual with the Club's finishing touches.

items.title: POCKETFUL OF MIDNIGHT
items.description: Seven tiny keepsakes gathered from the woods, garden, sky, night, the Club, and two sisters who know a thing or two about magic.

items.title: AFTER HOURS
items.description: A private digital extension of the Club, unlocked from inside your box.

includesClosingLine: Plus a few things we're keeping to ourselves.
